def transform(grid):
    """Compare the two equal-sized panels; mark positions sharing their common color."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find a full, uniform separator row or column.
    row_sep = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1), None)
    col_sep = next((c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1), None)
    if row_sep is not None:
        a, b = grid[:row_sep], grid[row_sep + 1:]
        if len(a) != len(b) or not a:
            raise ValueError("panels must have matching heights")
        common = set(x for row in a for x in row) & set(x for row in b for x in row)
        if len(common) != 1:
            raise ValueError("expected one color common to both panels")
        color = next(iter(common))
        return [[3 if a[r][c] == color and b[r][c] == color else color for c in range(w)] for r in range(len(a))]
    if col_sep is not None:
        a = [row[:col_sep] for row in grid]
        b = [row[col_sep + 1:] for row in grid]
        if len(a[0]) != len(b[0]) or not a[0]:
            raise ValueError("panels must have matching widths")
        common = set(x for row in a for x in row) & set(x for row in b for x in row)
        if len(common) != 1:
            raise ValueError("expected one color common to both panels")
        color = next(iter(common))
        return [[3 if a[r][c] == color and b[r][c] == color else color for c in range(len(a[0]))] for r in range(h)]
    raise ValueError("separator not found")
